subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: Should plugin subagent runs get a generic no-tools or toolsAllow contract, and should memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs use it by default?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but the durable fix defines a new plugin/gateway tool-policy boundary rather than a memory-core-only cleanup.

options.title: Add generic subagent tool restriction
options.body: Introduce a narrow SDK/protocol/gateway field for plugin subagent tool policy and set memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs to no tools or an explicit empty allowlist.

options.title: Prompt-only mitigation
options.body: Tighten the Dream Diary prompt without changing the tool surface, reducing model misuse but leaving the mutating tool available to that lane.

options.title: Leave as log noise
options.body: Accept the current fallback behavior and recurring errors as low-impact, while continuing to expose a workspace-mutating tool to a prose-only background run.

recommendation.title: Add generic subagent tool restriction
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow SDK/protocol/gateway field for plugin subagent tool policy and set memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs to no tools or an explicit empty allowlist.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the gateway/plugin SDK tool-policy boundary, and this person has recent history across those surfaces.
